title: ListOrganizerRequestsCallableResponse
description: People waiting across an organizer's coming events, soonest event first and oldest ask first within an event. complete is false when the bounded read left people out. Anyone with a block either way with the caller is left out.

kind.description: request: the host lets them in or declines. waitlist: the host can offer a spot.

waitlistPosition.description: Their place on this event's waitlist; null for a request.

attendedEventCount.description: Events they came to with this organizer; null when no contact is linked to them yet.

offerExpiresAtMillis.description: When a live waitlist offer runs out; null when none is live.
